snapshot.source: Google Flights and Hotels via SearchAPI

brief.title: Buenos Aires → Fortaleza
brief.window: Leave BA afternoon or evening Sep 10. Back by morning or afternoon Sep 15.
brief.pick: Book the Gol evening outbound with the LATAM morning return as one round trip. Stay on Beira Mar at Brasil Tropical. Check in Sep 10 so the room exists for the 01:50 landing. Book two dive windows on Sep 12 and 13. Do not dive Sep 14.

itineraries.name: Gol out, LATAM back
itineraries.windowNote: Only evening Sep 10 start that still lands the same night. Morning return lands BA in the afternoon.
itineraries.businessNote: Gol 737s have no real business cabin. LATAM A320 business is a recliner — book that return as a one-way if you want a premium cabin.

legs.note: Cheapest return that still fits the morning/afternoon ask.

itineraries.name: Gol same-day land
itineraries.windowNote: Afternoon BA start. In the hotel by 23:00. Costs more than the evening pairing.
itineraries.economyRtNote: Same outbound as a round trip is $2,259. Two one-ways are $282 cheaper.

itineraries.name: Gol evening one-way
itineraries.windowNote: Same flights as the recommended outbound. Pair with any return below.

itineraries.name: LATAM morning return
itineraries.windowNote: Leaves 06:00. Afternoon arrival in BA. Cheapest return that fits.
itineraries.businessNote: Domestic LATAM business on the A320 is a recliner, not sold as a clean one-way business fare on this date.

itineraries.name: Gol morning return
itineraries.windowNote: Also 06:00. Lands BA an hour later than LATAM, $345 more.

itineraries.name: LATAM + Turkish later return
itineraries.windowNote: Keeps a last beach morning. Lands BA at 22:25 — past the afternoon ask.
itineraries.businessNote: Turkish A350 is lie-flat. LATAM A320 business is a recliner.

itineraries.name: Turkish + LATAM overnight
itineraries.windowNote: Only round-trip business on this city pair. Departs 23:55 and lands Fortaleza at 11:05 on Sep 11 — you lose the first morning.
itineraries.businessNote: Outbound one-way business is not listed. This is the only way to fly premium both ways.

itineraries.name: Aeroparque (AEP)
itineraries.windowNote: Closer airport, worse product. Cheapest AEP one-way is $1,191 with a 5h 35m GRU layover. AR 17:30 to GIG is $1,600 and often delayed.
itineraries.businessNote: Skip AEP unless you refuse Ezeiza.

pricingCompare.note: Cheapest fare that fits both windows.

pricingCompare.label: One-ways, same pairing
pricingCompare.note: Same total as the round trip. Book whichever inventory is open.

pricingCompare.label: One-ways, same-day land
pricingCompare.note: Pays $282 to be in bed before midnight.

pricingCompare.label: Round trip, same-day Gol
pricingCompare.note: Worse than two one-ways. Do not book this as a round trip.

pricingCompare.label: Round trip, business
pricingCompare.note: Lie-flat on the A350 legs. No outbound one-way business is listed.

pricingCompare.label: Economy out + business back
pricingCompare.note: Cheaper than full business if you only want the lie-flat home.

business.note: Google Flights returned one round-trip business itinerary: Turkish A350 + LATAM A321 via GRU, $4,303 for two. One-way outbound business is not listed for Sep 10. One-way return business exists on LATAM + Turkish for $2,916.
business.lieFlat: Turkish A350 legs (TK 16 outbound, TK 15 return).
business.recliner: LATAM A320/A321 “business” is a recliner, not a flat bed. Gol 737s have no real business cabin.

hotels.name: Hotel Brasil Tropical
hotels.why: All-suite Beira Mar tower with a rooftop hot tub. The value pick this week: half the Holiday Inn rate, still at the Marriott bar if you get a renovated high floor.
hotels.caveat: Rooms vary. Some guests call it dated and not a real 4★. Ask for a renovated high floor.
hotels.diveFit: Uber 10–15 min to the Beira Mar 4320 meet or Mucuripe boats. Hotel pickup is not standard.
hotels.transferNote: Walk the beachfront. Taxi from FOR about 23 min.

hotels.name: Hotel Sonata de Iracema
hotels.why: 4.6 rating, ocean-view rooms, and the only listed airport shuttle. A notch more midscale than Holiday Inn, still at the bar.
hotels.caveat: Farther from the dive meet than Meireles. Useful if you want a named shuttle at 01:50.
hotels.diveFit: Uber 15–20 min to Mucuripe boats. Hotel pickup is not standard.
hotels.transferNote: Hotel airport shuttle. Taxi from FOR about 22 min.

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Fortaleza
hotels.why: Closest US-Marriott analog: IHG 4-star, pool, gym, Iracema/Meireles. Expensive this week at $244/night.
hotels.caveat: Guests report lukewarm water and thin soundproofing. No Marriott exists in Fortaleza until about 2028.
hotels.diveFit: Uber 10–15 min to Mucuripe boats. Hotel pickup is not standard.

hotels.name: Hotel Luzeiros Fortaleza
hotels.why: Five-star polish and beach-view restaurants on Beira Mar. Above a Courtyard; closer to a Marriott Downtown.
hotels.caveat: Renovation is ongoing. Confirm you are not next to the work.
hotels.diveFit: Uber 10–15 min to Mucuripe boats. Hotel pickup is not standard.
hotels.transferNote: Walk Beira Mar. Taxi from FOR about 23 min.

hotels.name: Hotel Gran Marquise
hotels.why: Best for diving: Mucuripe, spa, walk-up to the boats. Pays a $1,200 premium over Brasil Tropical.
hotels.caveat: Some rooms still have older AC. Worth it only if you want to walk to the dock at 06:30.
hotels.diveFit: Walk-up base for dive boats to Pedra da Risca do Meio.

skippedHotels.name: Mercure Fortaleza Meireles
skippedHotels.why: Accor 4-star on Beira Mar, but 4.2 rating with clustered sleep and bathroom complaints. Below the Marriott bar.

skippedHotels.name: Gran Mareiro Hotel
skippedHotels.why: Strong 5-star at Praia do Futuro. 20–30 min from Mucuripe dive boats. Use as a day trip, not the base.

skippedHotels.name: Beach Park Acqua / Suites / Oceani
skippedHotels.why: Water-park stays ~40 min from Mucuripe. Fine as a day trip, wrong as the dive hotel.

skippedHotels.name: Marriott / Westin / Sheraton
skippedHotels.why: No Marriott-flagged hotel in Fortaleza until about 2028. Holiday Inn is the closest US-chain analog.

diving.intro: The real dive is Pedra da Risca do Meio, 18 km and 50–90 min from Porto do Mucuripe. September is Fortaleza’s windiest month. Book two windows and confirm 24–48 hours ahead.

items.title: Site
items.detail: Ceará’s only state marine park. Depth 15–30 m, water 27–30 °C. Corals, rays, turtles, nurse sharks. Open Water required for the park; baptisms run at shallower coastal sites first.

items.title: Operators and prices
items.detail: Mar do Ceará (PADI): certified 2-tank about R$410–520 (~$76–96). Atlântida Mergulho (SDI): baptism R$500–600 (~$93–111), Open Water about R$1,500 (~$278). WhatsApp Atlântida +55 85 98818-9436.

items.title: Meet point
items.detail: Hotel pickup is not standard. Mar do Ceará meets at Beira Mar 4320 at 06:30, boat 07:00, back about 14:00. Uber from Brasil Tropical is 10–15 min. Gran Marquise can walk.

items.title: No-fly rule
items.detail: Do not dive Sep 14 or 15. Last boat is Sep 13 so you have 24 hours before the 06:00 LATAM. The 11:45 return is still too tight after a Sep 14 two-tank.

items.title: Swim beach
items.detail: Meireles, Iracema, and Mucuripe are poor for swimming. For a real beach day go to Praia do Futuro: Uber 10–17 min, about R$14–30 (~$3–6).

transfers.title: FOR → Meireles / Mucuripe
transfers.detail: Uber / 99 about R$19–50 (~$4–10), 15–25 min. Pickup is the signposted Aplicativos zone. Ignore curbside touts quoting R$100+. Metered taxi about R$47–70 (~$9–13). At 01:50, prebook a private transfer (~$15–29) if apps are thin. Sonata de Iracema lists an airport shuttle as the non-app backup.

transfers.title: In-city beach
transfers.detail: Walk Beira Mar from Meireles and Iracema hotels. No car needed. Swim at Praia do Futuro, not in front of the hotel.

transfers.title: Diving, Pedra da Risca do Meio
transfers.detail: Uber to Beira Mar 4320 or Porto do Mucuripe at 06:30. No hotel pickup on the offshore boats. Gran Marquise is the walk-up base.

transfers.title: Beach Park day trip
transfers.detail: Tour Fácil shared shuttle about 35–45 min, from R$55 per person (~$10), Sun / Mon / Fri / Sat. Park ticket is separate, about R$210–320. BeachTurJerí runs daily at about R$90 (~$17). Use as a wind-day fallback, not the hotel base.

transfers.title: Car rental
transfers.detail: Localiza and Movida sit at FOR arrivals, Piso 2, 24h. Skip the car on Beira Mar. Rent only if you add Cumbuco, Praia do Futuro, or Beach Park on your own schedule.

groundPlan.title: Leave Buenos Aires
groundPlan.detail: Afternoon Gol lands FOR at 22:15. Evening Gol lands 01:50. Book the room from Sep 10 either way.

groundPlan.title: Land and sleep
groundPlan.detail: Uber / 99 from the Aplicativos zone. Prebook a private car if you land at 01:50 and do not want to wait on apps. Sonata’s shuttle is the named backup.

groundPlan.title: Recover and book boats
groundPlan.detail: Sleep late if you took the 01:50. Walk Beira Mar. Confirm two dive windows (Sep 12 and 13) with Mar do Ceará or Atlântida. Do not swim in front of the hotel.

groundPlan.title: Dive windows
groundPlan.detail: Meet 06:30 at Beira Mar 4320. Boat about 50–90 min to Pedra da Risca do Meio. September trade winds cancel trips; keep both days open. Last legal boat is Sep 13.

groundPlan.title: Beach days
groundPlan.detail: Praia do Futuro for swimming. Cumbuco or Beach Park if the sea is too rough to dive. Sep 14 is a surface day, not a dive day.

groundPlan.title: Leave Fortaleza
groundPlan.detail: LATAM LA 3253 at 06:00 for the 15:45 EZE arrival. The 11:45 LATAM + Turkish still does not unlock a Sep 14 dive.
